settings.doc: Full Attack button + swing strip
Action pips count swings (2 → 1 → 0)
Off-hand / Nick / Flurry / Martial Arts / Hew buttons
Pole Strike only after the Attack action with a qualifying weapon
"+ Sneak Attack 3d6" on attack cards; auto mode per player
"Reckless Attack: On/Off" on the Special bar (applies the Reckless effect)
Two-Weapon Fighting @mod / Great Weapon Master +PB in the weapon's damage roll
a main-hand swing never inherits Offhand from the last roll
an off-hand swing spends the Bonus pip, not the Action pip
empty Argon weapon set 1/2 filled once for PCs (never overwrites)
Full Attack for NPC / Wild Shape Multiattack
mark Argon's one-time Target Picker Tutorial as seen; "right-click cancels" on its cursor label
Argon's Dash/Disengage/Dodge/Hide/Ready/Shove spend the Action; Dash adds Speed; Dodge ends; Hide rolls
Reaction bar weapon = "Opportunity Attack", spends the Reaction, not a swing
Esc closes a dnd5e roll dialog without clicking into it first
a cancelled attack roll deletes its own empty usage card
damage at 0 HP adds a Death Saving Throw failure (two on a crit)
status conditions (Prone, Poisoned, Dodging…) on the HUD portrait
the HUD follows the one token left selected and your combatant's turn
a player's targets are released when their turn ends
during a Full Attack each roll window sits just above the swing strip, named "swing i of n"
background tab: no floating canvas text, no chat-card pop-ups; a double destroy is ignored (core errors)
a Bonus-action feature or spell (Rage, Steady Aim, Divine Smite, Lay on Hands…) spends the Bonus pip
a self-only feature with one effect (Rage) switches its effect on when used (no Apply click)
Steady Aim gives a "Steady Aim" effect: next attack defaults to Advantage, Speed 0, gone after that attack
Argon's drawers (Use Feature, Cast Spell…) open above their own button, not at the HUD's far left
a spell or feature used from the HUD spends its Action / Reaction pip; pips survive a HUD re-bind
Quickened Spell makes the next 1-Action spell this turn spend the Bonus pip, not the Action
your token is selected again when an area handle or a summon you held is deleted
Enter in a usage window's number box (Lay on Hands' points) uses the ability
